How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. How to build an AI agent for your business — piece by piece PIECE 1 — CONTEXT, saved as assets. Hand it your business in writing: who you serve, what you sell, how you price, your tone, how your process flows. Save it as organized files — written once, permanent. That's the day-one packet every future agent (and every future model) runs on. PIECE 2 — TOOLS. Connect the doors your business already uses: CRM, marketing platform, calendar, invoicing. Now it can look up a customer, update a record, send the campaign, book the call. PIECE 3 — SKILLS (the one everybody sleeps on). A skill is a job written down the way YOU do it: how you qualify a lead, write a promotion, chase an invoice. Write the recipe once — it runs your way every single time. PIECE 4 — THE TRAINING LOOP. Week one it's decent. You correct it, memory makes the correction stick, and you keep checking its work until it earns trust. Every week it drifts closer to how you'd do it yourself. PIECE 5 — THE SCHEDULE. Give it shifts: Monday pipeline review, evening follow-up sweep. It shows up unasked. One agent runs well → add a second for another lane. Now you're staffing. PIECE 6 — CHAINING (the payoff). Skills call tools in sequence, and skills call other skills. One "monthly promo" skill: pulls best customers from the CRM → drafts the campaign in your saved voice → schedules the posts → sends the emails → logs every reply where your team looks. One command, five tools, three skills. Work that used to take a whole team, running as one recipe. Every piece is an asset: build it once, it keeps working, and everything new plugs into it. #aiagent #aiautomation
